strategy.thesis: A Y Combinator-style incubator focused solely on Southeast Asia, backing early-stage founders through biannual cohorts with hands-on product, fundraising and community support, connecting them to investors in Singapore and San Francisco.

program.eligibility: Early-stage / pre-Series A startups building in or for Southeast Asia

application.how_to_apply: Apply online via iterative.vc for the upcoming cohort

summary.en: Iterative is a Singapore-based incubator/accelerator focused exclusively on Southeast Asian early-stage founders. Founded in 2020 by Hsu Ken Ooi and Brian Ma, it runs two cohorts a year, investing US$150K–US$500K per startup over a 3-month program, and closed a US$55M Fund II in 2022.

strategy.thesis: A day-zero company builder that helps individuals find co-founders, form teams and launch ventures during a residency, then invests in the startups generated; industry-agnostic, focused on big markets and meaningful problems.

application_cycles: rolling; cohorts multiple times per year (e.g. residency starting October 2026)
program.eligibility: Aspiring founders (with or without a co-founder) and early-stage teams; idea-stage accepted

application.how_to_apply: Apply online for an Antler Singapore residency; AI-guided application, screening and partner call; pitch deck required

summary.en: Antler is a global day-zero venture builder founded in Singapore in 2017 by Magnus Grimeland and Fridtjof Berge. Its Singapore residency helps founders form teams and launch startups, investing US$150,000 for 10% equity plus an uncapped SAFE. It has invested in 1,500+ companies globally and is one of the most active early-stage investors worldwide.

strategy.thesis: The first global startup accelerator in Indonesia, a partnership between Silicon Valley VC Fenox and Japan's Infocom, providing seed funding, office space, mentorship and access to a global business network to connect SEA founders with international markets.

perks: access to Fenox VC and Infocom global network
program.eligibility: Early-stage startups in Indonesia / Southeast Asia

application.how_to_apply: Apply during open accelerator cohort calls

summary.en: GnB Accelerator is an Indonesia-based startup accelerator launched in 2016 as a partnership between Silicon Valley's Fenox Venture Capital and Japan's Infocom Corporation. It provides US$50,000 in seed funding for a ~10% stake, plus office space, mentorship and a global network. It has invested in 27 startups.

strategy.thesis: A Jakarta-based, world-class startup accelerator (originally powered by Google Developers Launchpad) nurturing Indonesia's next generation of startups through mentorship and a network of partners including Google, McKinsey and UBS.

summary.en: Digitaraya is a Jakarta-based startup accelerator created in 2017, originally powered by Google Developers Launchpad. Led by co-founder Nicole Yap, it has supported 70+ startups from multiple countries, offering mentorship from partners including Google, McKinsey and UBS, and runs corporate programs such as BCA's Synrgy Accelerator.

strategy.thesis: A private nonprofit founded by prominent Indonesian business leaders to catalyse early-stage entrepreneurship through incubation (Ciputra GEPI Incubator) and angel investment (ANGIN), linking Indonesian entrepreneurs to global investment prospects.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the Ciputra GEPI Incubator program

summary.en: GEPI is a private nonprofit founded in January 2011 by 13 prominent Indonesian business leaders to support early-stage entrepreneurship via incubation (the Ciputra GEPI Incubator) and angel investment (ANGIN). Described as Indonesia's first accelerator and coworking space, it awarded GOJEK US$10,000 in 2011.

strategy.thesis: A tech startup ecosystem builder running Thailand's first and largest coworking space network, with a mission to turn Thailand into a regional startup hub via coworking, tech media & events, and a workshop/academy; partnered with depa and Techstars.

summary.en: HUBBA is Thailand's first coworking space (opened 2012 in Bangkok by Amarit Charoenphan) that grew into a startup ecosystem builder running the country's largest coworking network across multiple cities, plus tech media, events, and an academy. It has partnered with depa and Techstars to support Thai startups.

strategy.thesis: Vietnam's first private innovation hub, run by SAIGONTEL, serving as a talent incubator and technology pilot hub focused on solving corporate innovation challenges for green growth — sustainable production, smart supply chains and eco-friendly transportation.

program.location: Quang Trung Software City, District 12, Ho Chi Minh City (>3,000 m2)
program.eligibility: Tech startups working on green growth and digital-transformation challenges

application.how_to_apply: Engage via SAIGONTEL / OITI open innovation programs

summary.en: SoiHub (SAIGONTEL Open Innovation Hub) was inaugurated on 25-26 October 2024 in Ho Chi Minh City as Vietnam's first private innovation center. Managed by SAIGONTEL, it spans over 3,000 m2 and serves as a talent incubator and technology pilot hub focused on green growth challenges such as sustainable production, smart supply chains and eco-friendly transportation.
summary.local: SoiHub (SAIGONTEL Open Innovation Hub) là trung tâm đổi mới sáng tạo tư nhân đầu tiên của Việt Nam, khai trương ngày 25-26/10/2024 tại TP.HCM, do SAIGONTEL quản lý, tập trung vào tăng trưởng xanh.

strategy.thesis: A Bandung-based incubation program emphasizing collaboration over facilities or funding, offering a digital/remote incubation program with modular entrepreneurship support that startups can choose as their needs evolve.

program.eligibility: Early-stage startups, especially in the Bandung area

summary.en: Kolaborasi is a Bandung-based incubation program operational since 2013, started by founders from different startups to create a place for startups to gather and learn together. It emphasizes collaboration over facilities/funding and offers a modular digital incubation program; alumni include Crowde, Mata Ilmu and Collective Fund.

strategy.thesis: An early-stage accelerator (now a VC, Ideabox Ventures) established by Indosat Ooredoo with Mountain Partners and Kejora, backing pre-Series A Indonesian tech startups with strong telco-synergy potential, supported by Indosat/Ooredoo commercial partnerships.

perks: Indosat/Ooredoo commercial partnerships, payment integration, mobile advertising
program.eligibility: Early-stage / pre-Series A Indonesian tech startups with telco synergy

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the Ideabox accelerator (F6S) or pitch Ideabox Ventures

summary.en: Ideabox is an Indonesian early-stage accelerator established jointly by Indosat Ooredoo, Mountain Partners and Kejora. Its accelerator runs a ~120-day program with initial funding up to US$50,000; in 2016 it evolved into Ideabox Ventures, able to fund up to US$500,000 per startup. Alumni include Pawoon, Wobe and Dealoka.
